questionText: Choose the part of the sentence that contains an error: (A) Neither of the two boys / (B) were present / (C) in the class / (D) today.
questionTextHi: वाक्य का वह भाग चुनें जिसमें त्रुटि है: (A) Neither of the two boys / (B) were present / (C) in the class / (D) today.
explanation: 'Neither' takes a singular verb — 'was present' is correct.
explanationHi: 'Neither' के साथ singular क्रिया आती है — 'was present' सही है।

questionText: Choose the correct passive form: 'They are building a new bridge.'
questionTextHi: सही passive रूप चुनें: 'They are building a new bridge.'

options.text: A new bridge is being built.
A new bridge has been built.
A new bridge was being built.

explanation: Present continuous passive: is/are + being + V3.
explanationHi: Present continuous passive: is/are + being + V3।

subject: english
questionText: He said, 'I am tired.' → He said that ____
questionTextHi: He said, 'I am tired.' → He said that ____
explanation: Reporting verb in past → present tense changes to past: 'he was tired'.
explanationHi: Reporting verb past में → present, past में बदलता है: 'he was tired'।
